evidence: Actual sandboxed Electron on GNOME/Wayland with generated fixtures; no Gateway connection
checks: real GNOME Wayland sandbox and isolated fixture Profile
actual 1000-message render scroll DOM and memory measurement
zero Gateway traffic and unchanged built resources

samplingCaveats: The baseline was measured before product rebuilding, against the recorded clean P4.2 source and manifest with the same 1000-message generated workload.

The early baseline enabled the Performance domain after rendering. LayoutDuration and RecalcStyleDuration zero entries are unavailable measurements and must not be compared to final P4.3 duration deltas.
Initial DOM/heap are point-in-time Chromium counters; no forced GC and no steady-state RSS claim. Baseline did not record heapAfterScroll.
One run per bundle is descriptive evidence, not a statistically controlled benchmark. Render, mounted elements and worst scroll frame improved in this sample, while p95 scroll time did not.

limitations: All histories and identities are generated test data, not native Codex execution.
Fixtures enter through the real main/preload event; credentials and Gateway handshake are not simulated as successes.
Network guard attaches after launch; the Profile starts empty and product policy also blocks renderer networking.
Playwright debugger loopback endpoints are automation plumbing, not a test Gateway.
Scripted composition events exercise IME guards; physical input method acceptance requires the separate Computer Use check.
No TLS/public network, production service changes, DEB or release work.

archive.sanitization: Generated fixture data only. Original baseline numeric evidence retained; no private profile or absolute host path included. Only final P4.3/P4.2 screenshots are archived in this package.
